rulings: lead, 20 November 2026: Q1 zero drive is mu_F = mu_W with held potentials including their activities; Q2 every arm compared by total variation, modality reported under the registered definition, the bimodal (d) world chosen by an exact search at M 14-16, the edge regime a reported counter-example, comparable amphiphile counts; Q3 V1 in this registration, the composed population run later; Q4 the switching time from the engine's table; Q5 the driven-law refusal is the builder's registration test; Q6 a constructed set with gamma = 0

rows.OL4-1: The pair identity with fuel: ln a+ - ln a- = -Delta F + w, w = -Sum_held nu mu (fuel note §5 check 1), with the forward form and the reverse rates; in worlds without geometry and in a vesicle world (V1)
rows.OL4-2: The cycle's drive: Sum ln(a+/a-) = mu_F - mu_W around every fuel cycle and 0 around every other (§5 check 3); Kolmogorov fails by exactly the drive
rows.OL4-3: Closure with fuel: F(n_t) - F(n_0) = W - Q at every row, held and finite fuel, and the payers' split W = Sum_h mu_h supplied_h (§5 check 2)
rows.OL4-4: Moieties: Sum M n - Sum_held M supplied constant for the block and the fuel (§5 check 5)
rows.OL4-5: True equilibrium: at mu_F = mu_W the stationary law is exp(-F)/Z, with beta > 0 and beta = 0 (§5 check 4); and with finite fuel; and in a vesicle (V1)
rows.OL4-6: The driven steady state: the law against the reference's, the fuel flux, mean heat rate = J A (§5 check 6), and on one long run the heat identity and the flux by a z-test
rows.OL4-7: Modality (reported, registered definition) and the mean switching time from the engine's table (§3 (d))
rows.OL4-8: §2.3's closed form, exact, with its nulls (equilibrium, beta = 0, the dividing null) and (d0); no engine record
rows.OL4-9: The registered refusals (L1: a factor on a pool-only step)

tolerances.kernel: 64u(4 + |ln a+| + |ln a-| + |dF|) per edge; 64u(rates + Sum |ln a| + |target|) per cycle
tolerances.payers: 2(16 u E (1 + max|mu|) + 4 u Sum|mu s|)

modality.definition: clusters of local maxima of the law of (L1@membrane, L2@membrane) over the 8-neighbourhood, ties merged, peaks >= 1/20 of the largest; kinds one_central, two_interior, two_edge, one_offcentre, other
modality.switch_regions: share f = L1/(L1 + L2) with L1 + L2 >= 2: R1 f >= 3/4, R2 f <= 1/4

search.what: evidence/search in the OL5 fuel staging folder: search_interior.py, candidates.py and their JSON-line outputs
